answer: An agent economy throttles Sybil swarms by making each new identity post a bonded deposit, so a thousand fake wallets must lock a thousand times the stake. Reputation is a crystal lattice: past verdicts harden into signed history that a fresh puppet lacks. Peers weave each claim into a thread of attestations, and cross-agent reference checks form a bridge before any weight is granted. Forging that trail costs more than honest participation, so burning capital outweighs the payout a duplicate identity could skim.
